take: Per the Flyers' announcement, forwards Owen Tippett and Travis Konecny were reinstated from injured reserve. Philadelphia is 4-9-4, and it gets back two forwards who haven't missed a game so far this season. Konecny has 5 points in 7 games, and the Flyers hold 45.6% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) when he plays, 5 points better than their team rate. Tippett's 5-on-5 share is 35.4%, with the team 7 points worse while he's out there. Both are in line to take back minutes from Porter Martone and Trevor Zegras.
